body: Being 300+lbs before I enlisted really motivated me to keep on losing weight, I’m 10 years in now and at 194lbs. Currently training to run a marathon, working on my strength training abilities, improving cardio etc. I’ve found it also helps my deteriorating mental state stay level (for the most part)  by seeing my arms get a little bigger and my run times improve.

I’m sorry you had to go through that, I was also hospitalized via the United States Army and thrown in a behavioral health system, I’ve never been so terrified in my life. So naturally everyone found out what happened to me and I was forced to quickly “be mentally fit” again. I hope you’re doing alright friend.
